hypothesis: Test whether a source-confirmed absence in a measured, high-usage unit improves a pregame forecast versus a fixed baseline; no injury point adjustment is assumed.
signal_inputs: Out/Doubtful lists by unit (verified); starter identity (unverified)
required_data_not_yet_verified: Timestamped injury status; official role/participation evidence; rights-cleared prices and outcomes

hypothesis: Test whether point-in-time practice/game status adds forecast value beyond a fixed baseline; do not infer a starter role, medical severity, or market mispricing from the designation alone.
signal_inputs: Practice status by day (verified for Week 10 only); odds (unverified)
required_data_not_yet_verified: Historical report versions, verified lineup/role, rights-cleared odds and results

hypothesis: Test whether a verified replacement’s measured opportunities change after the primary player is unavailable; do not assume a depth rank or workload effect.
required_data_not_yet_verified: Timestamped injury status; licensed player opportunity/snap data and prop prices; official results (access rights unverified)

hypothesis: Test dependence between specified same-game legs using aligned outcomes; estimate joint probability rather than assuming independence or universal correlation.
required_data_not_yet_verified: Aligned same-game leg outcomes, market/settlement definitions and licensed combination prices (not available)

hypothesis: Test whether cross-game legs are sufficiently independent; use independence only as a comparison benchmark, not as an assumption.
required_data_not_yet_verified: Aligned cross-game outcomes, season/week context and settlement definitions (not available)

hypothesis: Test whether forecast/market updates after a timestamped status report differ by report timing; this is untested and requires authorized line history.
signal_inputs: Report timestamps (not captured yet); line history (unverified)
required_data_not_yet_verified: Timestamped report versions and licensed, historical market-price snapshots (not available)

hypothesis: Test whether a confirmed absence plus a verified replacement/participation change in QB, OL, WR/TE or RB improves an offensive forecast versus a fixed baseline; do not infer a depth rank or fixed point adjustment.
signal_inputs: Timestamped injury report by offensive unit; confirmed role/participation change is not yet available.
required_data_not_yet_verified: Rights-cleared player-level participation and outcomes; dated depth/lineup evidence; licensed prices if market comparison is used.

hypothesis: Test whether a confirmed absence plus a verified replacement/participation change in DL, LB or DB improves an opponent scoring/efficiency forecast versus a fixed baseline; do not label a unit deficient from injury counts or an unverified rank.
signal_inputs: Timestamped injury report by defensive unit; official team-defense statistics are context, not a player-level replacement effect.
required_data_not_yet_verified: Rights-cleared player-level defensive participation and opponent-aligned outcomes; dated depth/lineup evidence; licensed prices if market comparison is used.
